title: Guilty Victim
description: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

title: Widower Syndrome
description: Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone.

title: The Special Affect
description: Expecting mother and artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

title: Tainted Waters
description: An unknowingly selfish mechanic, unable to save his failing business, agrees to take part in a four-man robbery. Now hiding out from the cops, he must survive the night in a room of people where he's not the most selfish.

title: False Profits
description: Delilah is imprisoned for fraud after being a part of her family's gospel group which was a front for a Ponzi scheme. She agrees to be interviewed by a local reporter about her past and her side of the crime.

title: Bottled Lust
description: Jasmine and her friends embark on a girls trip, as well as mend her heartbreak. She then meets John and is hit with a wave of feelings and butterflies. But when John starts to show his true colors, the girls end up in a dangerous situation.

title: Mistress for Hire
description: Skylar, a professional seductress hired for divorce leverage, falls for her target. As their connection grows, she reveals the truth, angering his wife. A dangerous game ensues, with love and survival on the line.

title: Deliveries From Eva
description: Disgraced music star Reese is surprised to learn that he still has a fan in the form of delivery driver, Eva. The two form an unlikely friendship that begins to sour due to Eva's growing obsession and her struggles with PTSD.

title: Bloodline of the Jewel
description: Bride to be, Nahdulay Ncala's world is turned upside down as she finds herself in the middle of a dangerous quest for a royal jewel. Traveling from Africa to America, Nahdulay connects with an unsuspecting driver who helps her uncover the truth.

title: Game of Cards
description: When data analyst Nicole Tucker's car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she's thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal.

description: Paroled after five years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by Benny, and her mother; their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder.

description: Malachi and Kiana leave Philadelphia for Atlanta seeking better opportunities. However, Malachi is lured by a seductive con artist, leaving everything hanging in the balance for the young couple.

description: When veteran judge Wiley Knott is pulled over for a minor traffic stop, he assumes it's nothing like always. However, this time the police arrest him, and take his five-year-old granddaughter.
